---
title: "Heatwaves, ozone and mortality in Santiago, Chile"
subtitle: "Combined effect of extreme temperature and ozone on mortality: evidence from Chile"
number-sections: false
toc: false
---

This site collects the reports of a study on whether simultaneous exposure to heatwaves and elevated ambient ozone has a combined effect on mortality in the urban municipalities of Santiago, Chile, during the warm seasons of 2009 to 2020.

The study uses a space-time-stratified case-crossover design with conditional logistic regression. Code and documentation are in the project repository; the data are not distributed with it.

## Reports

| Stage | Report | Status |
|-------|--------|--------|
| 1 | Exposure data: quality control and spatiotemporal trends | In preparation |
| 2 | Mortality data and case-crossover dataset | Planned |
| 3 | Main models and additive interaction | Planned |
| 4 | Sensitivity analyses and final technical report | Planned |
